question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 1.
solution:
The correct answer is '**help**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence discusses how reducing hours and optimizing shift rostering can reduce stress, burnout, and work-family conflict for healthcare workers.
 
• The verb “help” is the most appropriate choice here because it means to assist or contribute to achieving a positive outcome, which matches the intended meaning of the sentence.
 
• “Heal” refers to recovery from injury or illness and doesn’t fit the broader organizational context.
 
• “Hive” is a noun, typically referring to a beehive, and does not make sense in this context.
 
• “Host” is unrelated to the meaning of assisting or reducing issues, making it inappropriate in this sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

 

Complete Passage: *Reducing the hours worked and optimising shift rostering could (1) **help__** alleviate stress, burnout and work family (2) **_________****for healthcare workers. All this is likely to improve staff retention. Any reduction (3) **________****staff turnaround would save on direct costs associated (4) **_________****hiring new staff. The cost to replace a highly specialised healthcare professional can reach up to 200% of their annual salary. Also, (5) **__________****shorter shifts may increase the uptake of shift times that are usually hard to fill. Measures like shorter shifts could also appeal to part time workers or those who have retired.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Heal** – Means to cure or make healthy again. Not suitable for systemic or operational improvements.
 
• **Hive** – A noun referring to a structure for bees or metaphorically a busy place. Grammatically and contextually incorrect here.
 
• **Host** – Usually means to accommodate or organize. It does not fit the context of reducing stress or burnout.
 
• **Help** – Correct verb that indicates assisting or contributing to alleviating a problem, which suits the sentence perfectly.
